what: the decision for every meta-analysis or combination row of Paper 1's dictionary, under the rule of the release-resolution plan: a row is expanded only when every contributing release, endpoint, ancestry, version and role is explicitly documented and every contributing release is a dictionary row; nothing is inferred from cohort names, dates or counts; second version: one reason corrected after the cited document was read, no decision changed; third version: each decision states its basis and every decision resting on documentation cites the documents it rests on, which are fetched and pinned; no decision and no reason changed

dictionary.version: Paper 1 dataset dictionary, 121 rows, as frozen with Paper 1's plan at commit 82fb024ef0ac

rows.name: UKB-PPP full cohort (combined)
rows.reason: one study's own analysis of its own participants; it is itself a release and has no component releases among the dictionary rows

rows.name: MANOLIS and Pomak neurology (Png 2021)
rows.reason: one study's own analysis of two cohorts; it is itself a release and has no component releases among the dictionary rows

rows.name: Guangzhou Nutrition and Health Study (Xu 2023)
rows.reason: a single-cohort release matched by the word 'and' in its name; no component releases

rows.name: SCALLOP multi-cohort meta-analysis (Koprulu 2026)
rows.reason: the contributing SCALLOP cohorts' summary statistics are not dictionary releases, and the dictionary entry does not name the UK Biobank release that contributed

rows.name: UK Biobank + CARDIoGRAMplusC4D CAD (van der Harst 2018)
rows.reason: the overall meta-analysis combines the UK Biobank GWAS and the CARDIoGRAMplusC4D 1000 Genomes meta-analysis, which are dictionary rows, with the CARDIoGRAMplusC4D Metabochip meta-analysis, which is not a dictionary release

rows.name: AD and AD-by-proxy (Jansen 2019)
rows.reason: the UK Biobank by-proxy GWAS is the authors' own analysis, and the case-control consortia that contributed are not dictionary releases

rows.name: GIANT + UK Biobank height and BMI (Yengo 2018)
rows.reason: the UK Biobank GWAS is the authors' own analysis, not a dictionary release

rows.name: UK Biobank + ICBP blood pressure (Evangelou 2018)
rows.reason: the UK Biobank GWAS is the authors' own analysis and the ICBP stage is not a dictionary release

rows.name: UK Biobank + TAGC asthma (Han 2020)
rows.reason: the UK Biobank GWAS is the authors' own analysis, not a dictionary release

rows.name: Sakaue 2021 European meta-analysis (UKB + FinnGen R3)
rows.reason: the UK Biobank component is the authors' own harmonized analysis, not a dictionary release

rows.name: Sakaue 2021 cross-population meta-analysis (BBJ + UKB + FinnGen R3)
rows.reason: the UK Biobank component is the authors' own harmonized analysis, not a dictionary release

rows.name: FinnGen R12 + UK Biobank meta-analysis
rows.reason: the resource documents the European subset of pan-UKBB as the UK Biobank component, but states that for a subset of endpoints the UK Biobank side was redefined by FinnGen, which is not a dictionary release; which endpoints is given only in release mapping files, not in the documentation, so the composition is not documented for every endpoint

rows.name: FinnGen R12 + MVP + UK Biobank meta-analysis
rows.reason: the Million Veteran Program summary statistics are not a dictionary release, and the documentation admits imperfectly matching endpoints

rows.name: BCAC-CIMBA triple-negative / BRCA1 carrier meta-analysis (Zhang 2020)
rows.reason: the CIMBA BRCA1-carrier analysis is not a dictionary release
